what: Declarations for equation_search round 2 and the exact tier, written and committed BEFORE the specimen or any new code was run in this build. The commit that adds this file is the pre-run hash. A value that turns out badly is kept and the outcome reported; a later change is a new dated entry under 'amendments', never an edit.

f3_noise_floor.derivative_error: Richardson: central differences at dt and at 2*dt; error of the dt estimate = (d_2dt - d_dt) / 3
f3_noise_floor.sigma2: per component, mean of that squared error over the trajectory
f3_noise_floor.score: known-variance BIC: rss / sigma2 + k * ln(n); a term is added only if it lowers the score

f3_stlsq.threshold_units: coefficient of the unnormalised library term

round2.f3_pass_rule: planted Lorenz term sets recovered 3 of 3 on at least one branch; otherwise the failure is logged with cause OVER_SELECTION (a recovered set strictly contains the planted set), SWAP (same size, different terms) or OTHER

adequacy_gate.rule: a branch DISCOVERS a structure only if it selects at least one term AND one-step R^2 >= 0.5
adequacy_gate.r2: 1 - rss / tss; tss about zero for derivative targets (F2, F3), about the mean for the map target (F4)

nulls.f2: iid N(0,1) per coordinate, 500 steps, dt 0.01
nulls.f3: iid N(0,1) per coordinate, 500 steps, dt 0.005; each F3 branch scored
nulls.f4: iid uniform(0,1), 400 steps; discovery also needs the quadratic to beat the linear guard by BIC
nulls.reported: selected_any_term (no gate) and discovery (with the gate), both

f4_noise_sweep.noise: x_n + level * N(0,1), observation noise on the series
f4_noise_sweep.band_noisy_rows: 0.02 relative on r (the specimen's band; its source is UNSOURCED)
f4_noise_sweep.noiseless_row: relabelled SOLVER_CHECK; band 1e-6 relative on r

round2.f1_identifiability: the constant sequence: NON_UNIQUE when more than one exact hit; verdict void with the hit list; never pass

exact_tier.trigger: --exact, or auto when every coefficient and the step parse as rationals from text or integers; a float anywhere -> not engaged, logged
exact_tier.system: Lorenz sigma 10, rho 28, beta 8/3; explicit Euler, dt 1/200; start (1, 1, 1)
exact_tier.fit: exact linear solve over Fraction for the step map, one component at a time; unique iff the system has full rank
exact_tier.verify: every step by exact equality; first mismatch is located by step and component; no BIC

modular_branch.check: reconstructed coefficients verified exactly on every step under the cap and modulo each prime on every step

exact_tier.null: one recovered coefficient changed by 1/1000: the exact check must fail, located
